What makes this worse is that recently I was rejected by a girl who was everything I ever wanted, and no one harped her into lowering her standards or that she should date me cause "I am a 'good person'"

Your friend is the one who overstepped by disregarding your boundaries and applying a double standard. It’s okay to advocate for what you want in a partner.
